Commentary.Commentary: It is now time for the chase! The Pakistan openers, Shan Masood and Fakhar Zaman walk out to the middle. Adam Milne has the new ball in hand.
... THE CHASE ...

The Pakistani batters are in the form of their life. Just like the previous matches, they will hope one of them plays a big knock and help win this game. Will Pakistan clean-sweep or New Zealand will go home with something to cheer? We will find after the break.

Pakistan will be happy with how things ended. They bossed the final phase totally. The pitch was good to bat on and Pakistan had to come up with clever thinking, mostly slower balls to get the wickets and it helped them. It looked like they will give more than 300 runs but Shaheen Afridi and Haris Rauf bowled brilliantly at the back end. The former ended with three wickets while Rauf with one.

New Zealand have failed to end the innings on a high note. They could have easily crossed the 300-mark but kept on losing wickets in the fag end. They started well with Will Young been the aggressor. He was well accompanied by the skipper, Tom Latham as both added more than 70 runs. There were some quick knocks from Mark Chapman, Cole McConchie and Rachin Ravindra but they wanted a batter who could anchor the innings. There were left short in the end and have left 15-20 runs out there.

OUT! RUN OUT! Shorter and outside off. Sodhi flat-bats it to mid off where Shadab Khan has a shy and hits at the bowler's end. Ish Sodhi already gave up, he could have made his ground had he stretched his blade. New Zealand end with 299.

Commentary.Commentary: We are all set. Babar Azam is felicitated by Mohammad Rizwan as a special shirt is given to the skipper who plays his 100th ODI match. Tom Blundell and Will Young to open for the Kiwis. Shaheen Afridi to steam in first. Let's play...
Pakistan (PLAYING XI) - Shan Masood, Fakhar Zaman, Babar Azam (C), Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Iftikhar Ahmed, Agha Salman, Shadab Khan, Usama Mir, Shaheen Afridi, Mohammad Wasim, Haris Rauf.
New Zealand (PLAYING XI) - Will Young, Tom Blundell (WK), Henry Nicholls, Tom Latham (C), Mark Chapman, Cole McConchie, Rachin Ravindra, Adam Milne, Henry Shipley, Ish Sodhi, Matt Henry.
TOSS - New Zealand have won the toss and will BAT first!

Not much on stake for New Zealand and they will hope to end the series with a victory. However, the way they are performing it will be a hard outing if they don't perform at their highest. Pakistan on the other hand, are flying high and will look to end the tour with a win. Stay tuned for toss and other updates.

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of the fifth and final ODI between New Zealand and Pakistan. The home team have cruised so far as they have put on dominating performance game after game. They have a really good chance to clean-sweep the series with the home crowd at their back. New Zealand will be disappointed with how they have performed so far. The first couple of games were a bit close but the last two games were one-sided which didn't help them dearly.
